label: Bible Study
prompt: Blessed is he that _____, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
verse: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
note: Revelation opens with a blessing on whoever reads it aloud and whoever listens.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And this is the record, that God hath given to us _____ life, and this life is in his Son.
verse: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
note: The gospel in a sentence: God gave us eternal life, and that life is found in His Son.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the _____ of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
verse: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
note: God came walking in the garden in the cool of the day — and for the first time, his people hid instead of meeting him.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Be ye not as the horse, or as the _____, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verse: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
note: Don't be a mule that needs bit and bridle to go where it's told — learn to come willingly.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto _____ much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
verse: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
note: The stewardship principle in a sentence: 'unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required.'
